title: Yoke git hooks
current: The installed hooks find yoke on PATH, then at ${XDG_BIN_HOME:-$HOME/.local/bin}/yoke. A computer without Yoke commits with one line naming the computer and the install command; CI and the merge-queue preflight re-run the authored-file checks. Hook messages never suggest --no-verify. Refresh recognizes current hook contents or a matching install-record hash; uninstall removes hooks only when their contents match the recorded hash.
